title: C++: Worker Pool
description: Build a worker pool that processes tasks from a shared queue.

steps.title: Worker Pool
steps.description: Create a WorkerPool class that holds a queue of tasks (function<void()>) and a number of workers (simulated). Each worker takes the next task from the queue and executes it. Test with 5 tasks and 3 workers.
hints: Worker: while (hasTasks()) { auto task = dequeue(); task(); }
